intro: Roll this stream's followers, subscribers, gifters, supporters, raiders and moderators as movie-style credits. Names are collected from the events StreamBridge already receives, so no extra Streamer.bot trigger is needed.

sections.title: 1. Choose sections
sections.description: Pick the platforms and the groups of people to thank.
sections.notice: The list starts fresh each time your stream goes live. Chat lists every chatter and can get long on busy streams, so it is off by default.

sections.title: 2. Wording
sections.description: Change the headline, closing line and section headings.

sections.title: 3. When the credits roll
sections.description: By default the credits roll each time the scene that holds them is shown.
sections.notice: Moderators can type !credits to roll them, !credits stop to hide them, and !credits reset to start a fresh list.

sections.title: 4. Appearance
sections.description: Leave the background transparent to roll over your ending scene, or add a glass or solid panel.

sections.title: 5. Add to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs
sections.description: Open the overlay step below and copy the browser-source URL into your ending scene at 1920 x 1080.
